notes: Al-Zuhri takes the saying from two alternatives in one level, «عبد الله» and «الحسن» (rule 2)
«هما ابنا محمد ابن الحنفية» is the compiler's identification and «فذكر نحوه» means the matn is not written: both left out; the chain ends at the last named transmitters
«وقال غير سعيد بن عبد الرحمن عن ابن عيينة» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group with only the names the text gives
«وكان أرضاهما» and «قال الزهري» remarks are not links
